title: A filter for BLANK on a one-side column selects the fact rows with no matching dimension row
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ISBLANK ( Product[Color] ) ) )

source.quote: all the different values of Sales[ProductKey] with no corresponding row in Product are linked to the single blank row
source.supports: orphaned rows are linked to the blank row

source.quote: ALL includes in the result the additional blank row generated for invalid relationships
source.supports: the values of the column that the predicate filters include the blank row

source.quote: If a relationship is invalid, the VertiPaq engine automatically adds a row containing BLANK in every column of the table on the one-side of the relationship
source.supports: the blank row has BLANK in every column

derivation: The predicate filters the values of Product[Color], which are Red, Blue and the blank row's BLANK. Only the blank row is BLANK. The Sales rows linked to it are rows 3 and 4: 50 + 20 = 70.
